summary.text: NSG GROUP AS is a private limited company registered in Råde, founded 2023-03-13. NSG GROUP AS registers its business as consulting, sales, rental of equipment, machinery and tools, and services within building and construction. Its statutory purpose is the rental of scaffolding, machinery and lifts, as well as the assembly of scaffolding and other related services. It was previously named NSG ASSETS AS until 2023-12-21. Its main industry code is 43.990: other specialised construction activities n.e.c.. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 76 539 626 NOK and the annual result was 1 959 564 NOK; operating income was up from 34 139 758 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -1 580 400 NOK in 2024 to 1 959 564 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 026 587 NOK in 2024 to 3 181 951 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 63 on 2025-11-13 to 64 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: share capital set to 1 116 000 on 2025-12-11.
